purpose: Candidate external native signaling data for a separately registered test of biological response learning; not a completed validation or a source of metabolic flux labels.

readme.verified_scope: Repository item/bundle/bitstream metadata and the README only; no numerical measurement-array files downloaded or read

measurement_contract.platform: ALCATRAS microfluidics and DISCO brightfield-constrained segmentation
measurement_contract.missing_values: JSON null means the cell was absent at that time, not a measured zero
measurement_contract.median: Median fluorescence over the segmented cell area
measurement_contract.max5: Mean intensity of the five brightest pixels in the segmented cell area
measurement_contract.nucLoc: max5/median fluorescence ratio; a nuclear-localization proxy, not a directly measured phospho-Hog1 fraction
measurement_contract.nucLocNorm: Published normalization described in supplementary text; exact transformation must be audited before quantitative comparison
measurement_contract.times: Relative to origin; README plotting examples label minutes
measurement_contract.imBackground: Median pixel intensity outside segmented areas
measurement_contract.time_resolution: Not established from metadata; measurement arrays remain unopened
measurement_contract.strain_background: Not established from the inspected metadata

documented_conditions.complete_dose_inventory: Not claimed; only metadata/README examples were inspected

leakage_and_interpretation_gates: The README explicitly states fig2_stress_type_expts is the first replicate also present in fig2_stress_type_replicates. They cannot be treated as independent train/test files.
Split by complete biological experiment/replicate and declared condition, not random cells or time points from the same movie.
Audit nucLocNorm and background/peak processing using the supplement before deciding what normalization can be estimated from training versus fixed assay definitions.
Do not substitute nuclear localization for Hog1PP_measured or label unpaired factor strains as simultaneous multivariate observations.
Register model, observation transform, baselines, negative controls and whole-experiment heldouts before opening any measurement arrays for a final test.
Verify inherited model/data lineage before declaring this an independent validation source; metadata availability or later publication date alone does not certify every dependency.
This dataset does not provide measured glycerol flux, enzyme-specific catalytic capacity, dry biomass or an absolute native HOG-to-GEM volume conversion.
catalogue_discrepancies: README description headings call the nuclear-marker and rich-to-rich assets figS2 and figS8, whereas the repository API exposes figS1 and figS7; the IDs/URLs above follow actual bitstream metadata.
Data-file SHA256 values are intentionally absent until acquisition; only README bytes were opened and hashed in this metadata-only review.
